title: Finite torsors
statement:
For a finite abelian group $M$ and a scheme $Y$, let $\underline M_Y$ be the constant sheaf on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. An $M$-torsor on $Y_{\Et}$ is a finite locally constant sheaf of sets $P$ equipped with an action of $\underline M_Y$ such that the map

$$
\underline M_Y\times P\longrightarrow P\times P,\qquad (m,p)\longmapsto(m+p,p),
$$

is an isomorphism of sheaves, and such that every object $U$ of $Y_{\Et}$ has an etale covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ for which $P(U_i)$ is nonempty. Write $\operatorname{Tor}^1(Y,M)$ for the pointed set of isomorphism classes of $M$-torsors on $Y_{\Et}$.

lean.note: For Y : Scheme.{u} and M : Type (u + 1) with [AddCommGroup M] [Finite M], use G = (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M).
